Selected projects

Gigaboard

In development

Gigaboard is a Swift iOS app built around an Android-style clipboard and a highly customizable keyboard. Flick the spacebar to switch easily into one-handed mode. Customize typing and swipe behavior, each key’s color, toolbar layout, and one-handed width. Custom keyboard layouts are planned.

The app includes swipe typing, suggestions, and autocorrection. The companion app manages keyboard settings and personalization. Choose from a variety of themes, including Liquid Glass, create your own, or set a custom background image. The keyboard also has an offline emoji picker and GIF search powered by KLIPY.

Privacy comes first: your typing stays on-device, and Gigaboard doesn’t collect or send what you type. Clipboard features stay under your control; GIF searches go to KLIPY when you choose to search. Typing accuracy, speed, emoji navigation, and onboarding are still being refined. A new text engine is in progress, with beta testing planned before an App Store release.

Swift · iOS app · Custom keyboard · On-device typing
